summary: Retested SectionAnchors floating nav fix on Home (/) and System (/xo-vision-care-system) pages. The bug (nav locked to section 01 after scrolling past section 1) is FIXED. Nav correctly stays visible/pinned via position:fixed with JS-measured left/width across all tracked sections, active indicator updates as each section enters viewport, hidden before first section and past last section, hidden below lg breakpoint. No console/runtime errors. No layout regressions observed.
critical_code_review_comments: SectionAnchors.jsx: on very short pages (like Home where max scrollY=6757 < demo bottom offset), the demo section never fully exits viewport, so nav technically remains visible at absolute page bottom while the demo section is still partially in view. This is expected behavior per the visibility logic (lastRect.bottom > TOP_OFFSET) and matches the requirement 'only disappearing once scrolled past section 05'. On System page (taller), nav correctly hides at bottom.

Review request stated System.jsx ANCHORS has 4 items (problem, outcomes, replaces, deployment) but it actually has 8 items also including schedule/exam/fit/finish. Testing confirmed all work correctly; just flagging documentation drift.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Home page verified at 1920px & 1280px viewports. Scroll positions tested for each section id (capacity/system/delivers/proof/demo on Home; problem/outcomes/replaces/deployment on System). Active indicator confirmed via .text-xo-blue class on anchor buttons. Nav wrapper is <div ref=wrapperRef class='hidden lg:block'>, inner nav gets inline style position:fixed with left/width from wrapper.getBoundingClientRect(). Visibility toggled by comparing wrapperRect.top and lastSection.bottom against TOP_OFFSET=128.
rca of the issue: Fix verified: previous position:sticky was scoped to a grid column that only spanned section 1 (capacity/problem), so nav unstuck at end of column. New implementation uses JS-driven position:fixed with left/width measured from a hidden wrapper div that still lives in the grid column (preserving horizontal alignment at any viewport width), and visibility gated by scroll range between first and last tracked section. Correctly handles both boundaries.
